text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the track,
Taiki Shuttle came running toward me happily.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, pleeease listen!
Someone asked me to be their training partner again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This is all your fault, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The girl who asked said
that my running would make a great reference!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
She said she wanted to know why her running style became more versatile.
So, I told her!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's all because Trainer taught me! That's why!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A new world where speed alone isn't enough to win, and the thrilling rush of overcoming it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ever since I met you, Trainer, my heart just hasn't stopped pounding!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: She's always so fiery and passionate, like a blaze...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...You'll take full responsibility for teaching me
something so exciting, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a future we'll make TOGETHER!
If we don't protect it, it's BANG! for us, YES!

...While appreciating her kind thoughts, I swore
to myself that I had to teach her proper Japanese
before anyone got the wrong idea.
